hunks.baseline: Deep within a dark cave where a faint light seeped in, a small old man sat cross-legged, contemplating himself.
hunks.sol: Deep within a dark cave where only a faint light seeped in, a small old man sat cross-legged in quiet contemplation.

hunks.baseline: An energy like the sun raced through hundreds of acupoints and into the Eight Extraordinary Meridians. Tangible energy rose and enveloped the old man’s entire body.
hunks.sol: Energy like the sun raced through hundreds of acupoints and into the Eight Extraordinary Meridians. It took on physical form, rising to envelop the old man’s entire body.

hunks.baseline: Then, the changes began.
hunks.sol: Then the changes began.

hunks.baseline: Three flower buds bloomed above the old man’s snow-white hair before soon disappearing.
hunks.sol: Three flower buds bloomed above the old man’s snow-white hair, then vanished.

hunks.baseline: As the buds formed, the scattered energy created a new shape: five rings radiating a dazzling spectrum of colors.
hunks.sol: As the buds formed, the energy they scattered took on a new shape: five rings radiant with dazzling, multicolored light.

hunks.baseline: It was a phenomenon that could only be displayed by one of the chosen few among Supreme Peak masters who had reached the realm of Five Qi Returning to Origin.
hunks.sol: It was a phenomenon manifested only by the chosen few among Supreme Peak masters who had attained Five Qi Returning to Origin.

hunks.sol: The five rings symbolizing Five Qi Returning to Origin turned red. Tremendous fire qi erupted from the rings of internal energy brimming with Scorching Yang Qi, coiling around the old man before taking on a blue hue.

hunks.sol: When the fire in a furnace grew hot enough, it turned blue. The realm of martial arts the old man had attained was no different.

hunks.baseline: It would not have been an exaggeration to say that the internal energy and insight he had accumulated over more than a hundred years had already reached the ultimate.
hunks.sol: It was no exaggeration to say that the internal energy and insight he had accumulated over more than a hundred years had already reached the ultimate.

hunks.baseline: The old man, Fire King Jeok Cheongang, withdrew his internal energy. The figure that had been floating cross-legged in the air descended until his body touched the ground, and the strange phenomenon surrounding him vanished as though it had been washed away.
hunks.sol: The old man, Fire King Jeok Cheongang, withdrew his internal energy. His cross-legged figure descended from where it floated in midair, and the moment he touched the ground, the strange phenomena surrounding him vanished without a trace.

hunks.baseline: The only thing left in the quiet space was Jeok Cheongang’s hollow chuckle.
hunks.sol: Only Jeok Cheongang’s hollow chuckle remained in the silent cave.

hunks.baseline: Because he knew that fact better than anyone, Jeok Cheongang nodded, yet the unmoving wall still seemed bitterly unfortunate. At times, he even resented the heavens.
hunks.sol: He knew the reason better than anyone. He nodded in acknowledgment, yet he could not help regretting that the wall refused to budge. He even resented the heavens for it.

hunks.sol: But Jeok Cheongang had been unable to clear away the dregs that had accumulated in his heart over the past several decades.

hunks.sol: Anything left to pile up and stagnate would eventually rot. His rotting heart filled with worldly anguish, inviting an inner demon—and once that inner demon took hold, he could no longer ward off the infirmities of old age.

hunks.sol: “If I hadn’t met that brat… I’d probably be smearing shit on the walls by now. Heh heh.”

One.

hunks.baseline: With one realization—just one small realization—he might be able to reach the realm of Returned to Youth.
hunks.sol: If he could attain just one small insight, he might reach the realm of Returned to Youth.

hunks.baseline: But he knew that this, too, was greed. It was proof that he had not completely emptied his heart.
hunks.sol: But he knew that desire was greed as well. Proof that he had not completely emptied his heart.

hunks.baseline: When he suddenly looked up, he saw the sky through a small opening. Jeok Cheongang spoke to someone invisible beyond it.
hunks.sol: He looked up. The sky was visible through a small opening in the cave, and Jeok Cheongang addressed someone unseen beyond it.

hunks.baseline: “Does this mean I should be satisfied with this? Is that right?”
hunks.sol: “Does this mean I should be satisfied with what I have? Is that it?”

hunks.baseline: No answer came back.
hunks.sol: No answer came.

hunks.baseline: No… Perhaps he had already received his answer.
hunks.sol: Or perhaps he had already received one.

hunks.baseline: He had taken a killer demon by nature as his disciple and allowed innocents to die. But thanks to his second disciple, he had at least been able to preserve his sanity. The answer was that he should no longer cling to anything.
hunks.sol: He had taken a born killer as his disciple and caused innocent people to die. Yet thanks to his second disciple, he had at least managed to preserve his sanity. The answer was that he should no longer cling to anything more.

hunks.baseline: There was no one to give him that answer, yet Jeok Cheongang heard it coming from within his own heart.
hunks.sol: No one had spoken, but Jeok Cheongang heard the answer within his own heart.

hunks.baseline: “What a fucking joke. After all the fiends this old man has dealt with, this is the shabby treatment I get?”
hunks.sol: “What a fucking joke. After all the fiends this old man has dealt with, this is how I’m treated?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang sighed in complaint and lowered his head before continuing.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang sighed in complaint, lowered his head, and continued.

hunks.baseline: One person stood at the end of Jeok Cheongang’s gaze. Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng answered while waving his folding fan.
hunks.sol: A man stood where his gaze came to rest. Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng waved his folding fan as he answered.

hunks.sol: “When I was nine, my grandfather once sat me beside him and said something similar. ‘I don’t know what bastard is up there, but he must have a truly god-awful temper.’ You are saying the same thing now, Senior.”

hunks.baseline: “He was smarter than you, of course. At least he didn’t wave his fan insolently in front of someone old enough to be his grandfather. Fold that thing before I break it.”
hunks.sol: “He was also smarter than you. At least he didn’t have the bad manners to wave a fan in front of someone old enough to be his grandfather. Fold that thing before I break it.”

hunks.baseline: “It is not an object that breaks easily. I put two nyang of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron into it.”
hunks.sol: “It will not break easily. I had two nyang of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron worked into it.”

hunks.sol: “But what brings you here? The search is already over, and no one comes here anymore.”

hunks.sol: “That is precisely why I came. This old man knows nothing about mechanisms and formations, so I have to prepare in my own way.”

hunks.baseline: At the word *preparations*, Zhuge Feng’s brow rose slightly.
hunks.sol: At the word *prepare*, Zhuge Feng’s eyebrows rose slightly.

hunks.baseline: “You think a battle will break out.”
hunks.sol: “You believe there will be a battle.”

hunks.baseline: “A martial artist should always prepare for a fight. Besides, those bastards from Dark Heaven are cruel, lawless, and persistent. This will not end here.”
hunks.sol: “A martial artist should always be prepared for a fight. Besides, those Dark Heaven bastards are brutal and persistent. This will not end here.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. I also know that, through Young Hero Jin, he called Dark Heaven the successor of the Demonic Cult before meeting his death.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. I also know that before his death, he told Young Hero Jin that Dark Heaven was the successor to the Demonic Cult.”

hunks.baseline: The Great Faction War, fought over supremacy in the world, had ended with victory for the orthodox factions. But it had not been a sweeping victory. It had been a victory marked only by wounds.
hunks.sol: The Great Faction War, fought for supremacy over the world, had ended in victory for the orthodox faction. But it had not been a sweeping victory. It was a victory that left nothing but wounds.

hunks.baseline: If the orthodox factions of that era had retained enough strength, they would have pursued the retreating armies of the Demonic Cult and torn out every last one of its roots.
hunks.sol: Had the orthodox faction retained enough strength at the time, it would have pursued the retreating forces of the Demonic Cult and torn out every last root.

hunks.baseline: But the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult and the orthodox factions—the two great powers, like a dragon and a tiger—had lost most of their strength as soon as the war ended. And the long gap of more than fifty years had been enough time for the defeated side that escaped to rise again.
hunks.sol: But the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult and the orthodox faction—the dragon and tiger—had both lost most of their strength when the war ended. The long interval of more than fifty years had given the defeated survivors ample time to rise again.

hunks.baseline: “Time has passed like this before we even realized it. The wheel has turned, and troubled times have come again.”
hunks.sol: “So much time has passed before we knew it. The wheel has turned, and troubled times have come again.”

hunks.baseline: At Jeok Cheongang’s quiet voice, Zhuge Feng suddenly looked up.
hunks.sol: At Jeok Cheongang’s quiet words, Zhuge Feng looked up.

hunks.baseline: The sky visible through the gaps in the cave ceiling was dark and chaotic. Even if the black clouds vanished tomorrow and the sky cleared to blue, the heavenly patterns had already been thrown into such disorder that no diviner in the world would be able to read them.

hunks.baseline: The age of turmoil had finally returned after completing its long circle, and the era of calamity had already reached their doorstep.
